stories.title: Discurso de Trump contra México tira al superpeso

en.title: Trump's Rhetoric Against Mexico Weakens the Mexican Peso
en.summary: The Mexican peso depreciated 31 cents during the month and closed at 17.30 per dollar, its weakest level in 7 weeks. Analysts project it will end the year at 17.50.

stories.title: A inventario, la colección de arte del MARCO

en.title: MARCO Art Collection Inventoried
en.summary: The art collection at MARCO is being cataloged and inventoried.

stories.title: OCDE sube de 0.8% a 1.5% previsión de PIB para 2026

en.title: OECD Raises 2026 GDP Forecast from 0.8% to 1.5%
en.summary: The OECD increased its economic growth projection for 2026, raising the forecast to 1.5% from its previous estimate of 0.8%.

stories.title: Ven daño a la inversión si quitan ruta a Ferromex

en.title: Concerns Raised About Investment Damage if Ferromex Route is Removed
en.summary: Following the President's announcement that a railway concession will be reviewed, analysts call for transparency in the process and improved security measures.

stories.title: Pequeñas editoriales: difícil camino para vender libros al Estado

en.title: Small publishers: difficult path to sell books to the State
en.summary: Small publishing houses face significant challenges in attempting to sell their books to government institutions.

stories.title: Diputados frenan doble nacionalidad para candidatos

en.title: Deputies block dual citizenship for candidates
en.summary: A modification to Article 82 requires presidential candidates to have no other nationality, or to renounce it before registering their candidacy.

stories.title: Diputados avalan reforma contra la doble nacionalidad para candidatos a la Presidencia y gubernaturas; pasa al Senado

en.title: Deputies approve reform against dual citizenship for presidential and gubernatorial candidates; advances to Senate
en.summary: Deputies have approved a reform eliminating dual citizenship eligibility for presidential and gubernatorial candidates, which now proceeds to the Senate for consideration.

stories.title: Disparos cerca de campamento de madres buscadoras frente a la FGR en CDMX: ¿Qué se sabe?

en.title: Gunshots near encampment of searching mothers in front of FGR in Mexico City: What is known?
en.summary: Gunfire broke out near an encampment of mothers searching for missing persons outside the Mexican federal prosecutor's office, with authorities providing support and confirming the arrest of a robbery gang.

stories.title: Se reportan disparos en inmediaciones de sede de FGR donde madres buscadoras mantienen plantón; SSC CDMX aclara que se trató de una detención de presuntos delincuentes

en.title: Shots reported near FGR headquarters where search mothers maintain protest; CDMX SSC clarifies it was arrest of suspected criminals
en.summary: Gunfire was reported near Mexico's federal prosecutor's office during a protest by mothers searching for missing persons. Authorities stated the shots were fired during the apprehension of suspects allegedly involved in a home robbery in Coahuila.

stories.title: Avalan reforma para que aspirantes dejen doble nacionalidad

en.title: Approve reform so candidates renounce dual nationality
en.summary: Mexico's lower house approved a constitutional reform prohibiting candidates for federal and state executive offices from holding dual nationality.

stories.title: Huracán Polo se intensifica a categoría 5; EN VIVO, últimas noticias del ciclón

en.title: Hurricane Polo intensifies to category 5; LIVE, latest news of the cyclone
en.summary: Mexican authorities issued alerts for intense rainfall, strong winds, and coastal surges affecting six states as Hurricane Polo intensified.

en.title: Hurricane Polo evolves to category 5
en.summary: Hurricane Polo reached category 5 intensity south of Zihuatanejo, Guerrero and south-southeast of Manzanillo, Colima, according to Mexican water authorities.

stories.title: Plan México necesita algo más que inversión para funcionar, advierte Mariana Mazzucato

en.title: Plan México needs more than investment to work, warns Mariana Mazzucato
en.summary: Economist Mariana Mazzucato cautioned that Mexico possesses various policy tools but must integrate them toward shared objectives rather than implementing them separately.

stories.title: Emilio Azcárraga quiere ascenso y descenso, pero explica por qué hoy no es viable económicamente en México

en.title: Emilio Azcárraga wants promotion and relegation, but explains why it is not economically viable in Mexico today
en.summary: The América football club chairman expressed support for implementing promotion and relegation but outlined economic reasons why such a system is currently not feasible in Mexico.

stories.title: La china Changan va por el trono de Toyota: su nuevo plan para entregar refacciones en tiempo récord

en.title: Chinese Changan aims for Toyota's throne: its new plan to deliver spare parts in record time
en.summary: Changan has partnered with Estafeta to compete with established Japanese automakers in Mexico by offering faster spare parts delivery.

stories.title: Soriana acelera inversión con más de 961 mdp para abrir y remodelar tiendas en el país

en.title: Soriana accelerates investment with over 961 million pesos to open and remodel stores in the country
en.summary: Soriana will invest over 961 million pesos to open and remodel 26 stores, create 1,000 jobs in Nuevo León and Veracruz, and strengthen its omnichannel operations.

stories.title: El Nokia 1100 también se fabricó en México: la planta que estuvo detrás del celular más vendido en la historia

en.title: The Nokia 1100 was also manufactured in Mexico: the plant behind the best-selling phone in history
en.summary: Mexico manufactured the world's best-selling mobile phone, the Nokia 1100, as well as other Nokia models.
